purpose: Resource preflight and output contract only; no FIT worker is launched by this protocol.

population.selection: The 403 metadata-nonempty FIT videos inherited by full_collection_plan; no outcome, identity, category, GT, posterior, or tracker-ID selection.
population.candidate_rule: For every same-video frame pair at the exact sampled frame_id lag, retain the complete Q x M Cartesian candidate population. A candidate is never removed by MNN, availability, exclusion, gain, or any label.
population.frame_pair_chunk: One independently sealed chunk per (video_id, lag, query_frame_id, reference_frame_id); no cross-video pair and no in-memory full-FIT matrix.

arms.fullpool: Canonical raw strict-positive reciprocal MNN over the full valid row pool; this arm is a diagnostic control and does not filter candidates.
arms.row_excluded: Before rematching, remove the candidate query row and reference row; then recompute strict-positive reciprocal MNN.
arms.proposal_overlap_excluded: Before rematching, remove each endpoint, all equal roi_proposal_row rows, and every row with direct positive-area overlap with that endpoint box; no transitive closure.
arms.missing: Candidate remains in the chunk. Its arm is available=0, anchor_count is retained, and donor-dependent values are NaN; missing is never converted to zero or identity motion.

edge_output.format: NPZ chunk written with exclusive create, then hashed; no edge-level anchor tuple JSON.

arrays.static_abs_L1: float64[N] candidate centre displacement normalized by pair scale
arrays.translation_xy: float64[N,3,2] original-image-pixel median translation; NaN when unavailable
arrays.corrected_L1: float64[N,3] corrected normalized displacement; NaN when unavailable
arrays.gain: float64[N,3] static_abs_L1 - corrected_L1; NaN when unavailable
arrays.fit_key: uint64[N,3] truncated SHA-256 key of arm plus endpoint exclusion digests
arrays.anchor_hash: uint8[N,3,32] SHA-256 of ordered uint32 anchor row pairs; empty-anchor hash is deterministic
arrays.mask: uint8[N] bit 0 fullpool-MNN candidate, bits 1-3 arm availability, bit 4 finite static geometry

endpoint_tables.query_exclusion_hash: uint8[Q,3,32] full SHA-256 for canonical sorted query exclusion rows, once per endpoint
endpoint_tables.reference_exclusion_hash: uint8[M,3,32] full SHA-256 for canonical sorted reference exclusion rows, once per endpoint

edge_output.key_definition: fit_key is the uint64 little-endian interpretation of the first eight bytes of SHA-256(domain=scene-residual-fit-key-v1, arm name, query exclusion SHA-256, reference exclusion SHA-256). Full endpoint digests remain in endpoint_tables so an auditor can detect a key collision.
edge_output.anchor_hash_definition: SHA-256(domain=scene-residual-anchor-v1 followed by C-contiguous little-endian uint32 ordered (query_row,reference_row) pairs).
edge_output.provenance: A chunk receipt binds input frame locators, Q/M, candidate count, array shapes/dtypes, output SHA-256, endpoint-table SHA-256, previous receipt hash, and protocol SHA-256. Full anchor tuples are reconstructed by a fresh auditor from the pinned raw cache and anchor_hash.

streaming_and_recovery.manifest: append-only canonical JSONL; each line includes previous_receipt_sha256 and receipt_sha256
streaming_and_recovery.resume: Only a complete prefix with verified output, input, and hash-chain pins may continue. Never overwrite, retry, or reinterpret a partial chunk.
streaming_and_recovery.finalize: After all chunks, independently recompute counts, hashes, and arm values from raw cache; only then write global seal and any later FIT identity join.

resource_planning.pilot_scope: The pinned four-frame pilot measured one proposal-overlap arm and 8,692 candidates; its elapsed time is a scaling reference only, not a runtime guarantee.
resource_planning.memory_rule: Only one frame-pair and its arrays may be resident; no full-FIT candidate array, fit-record list, or edge anchor tuple collection.
resource_planning.metadata_only_preflight: This draft and its preflight read plan/frame metadata and hashes only; they do not open NPZ payloads, run scene residual, launch a worker, or create the output directory.

interpretation: A passing preflight establishes only a frozen, resumable CPU output contract and resource estimate. It establishes no identity correctness, physical camera motion, tracking gain, generalization, or novelty.
